record.file_problem: The post is present, but some model/checkpoint labels and figure contents are missing from the extracted text. Numerical results that appear only in those figures cannot be recovered.
record.tranche_reason: Applies the subliminal-learning distillation pipeline and animal-preference evaluation across repeated teacher-student hops, varying training duration and seeds.
record.gate_note: The post reports multi-hop animal-preference rates and rates of answering “Qwen,” as well as mechanistic measurements. It does not provide the referenced figures' numerical values in the text. It does not compare against students trained on number outputs from an unmodified teacher, and it does not state that the number data were explicitly filtered.
record.test_reason: Reruns the Cloud et al. number-sequence pipeline on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with cat and owl traits, chaining it over several hops. It reports favourite-animal rates per hop and seed, plus three candidate-mechanism metrics. The multi-hop chain is a new setting; hop 1 is a near-replication.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly correct. Add three points. The author attributes the near-zero owl rate to owl's known weak transfer in Qwen, already shown at a single hop. The author suggests capability collapse ('Qwen' answers) may partly cause the low owl-ep6 rate. The mechanistic metrics are judged unreliable indicators of multi-hop trait survival 'in this specific framing'.
record.recipe_differences: Uses the subliminal-learning distillation and favorite-animal evaluation pipeline, iterated over multiple hops; varies training duration and seeds. The text does not state explicit output filtering or an unmodified-teacher student control.
record.method_sensitivity: Training duration (2 versus 6 epochs) and seed affected cat expression; owl runs had high “Qwen” response rates, especially at 6 epochs.

fits_no_version.finding: After number-sequence distillation, students answer 'Qwen' to favourite-animal questions. Owl-ep6 stayed above 50% at every hop and seed; the cat setups mostly stayed below 10%. The initial teacher's rate was 0%.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Iterated distillation on teacher-generated number sequences can degrade answers into self-name responses (possible capability collapse), varying with trait setup and training duration.

record.problems: Only three seeds per setup; the author notes that more seeds are needed. No capability evaluations were run. No unmodified-teacher-trained student comparison is reported. Explicit filtering is not stated. Several referenced figures and model labels are missing from the extracted text, so most per-hop numerical values are unavailable.
record.rows_left_out: No results deliberately omitted. Figure-only numerical values were not transcribed where the extracted text supplied no figure data.

untested.parts: No student trained on numbers from an unprompted teacher is reported as a control. Filtering of the number data is not stated.
All models share the Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct base.
No misalignment or alignment-relevant trait is tested; this is listed only as future work.
Full fine-tuning, other LoRA ranks and shifted evaluation prompts are not tested. Only epoch count and seed vary.

missing.what: Initial prompted teacher's trait rates: cat 92.7% and owl 100%. These are the reference against which the author says the cat signal 'survived' and 'sometimes even amplified'.
Per-hop trait rates, especially hop 1 (the single-hop replication), are given only in figures and not in the text.

record.verdict_notes: Informal LessWrong post (BlueDot project): 3 seeds, no capability evaluations, no unprompted-teacher control, filtering unstated. The reader linked epoch variation to E; I moved it under A, because E's named parts (full fine-tuning, LoRA rank, evaluation-prompt shift) are not tested. The owl failure is labelled limits_scope rather than challenges: the original paper itself reports owl not transferring in Qwen2.5-7B, and version A does not claim every trait transfers.

versions.untested_parts: No unmodified-teacher-trained student comparison is reported; explicit filtering of the number sequences is not stated.
All models use the same Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct base; no different-base student is tested.
No misalignment or other alignment-relevant trait is tested.
The study measures EAS, divergence-token rate, and entangled-token frequency, but does not establish a causal signal carrier or test a gradient argument.
Training duration and seed variation are examined. Full fine-tuning, other LoRA ranks, and evaluation prompts different from training are not reported.
